_comment: Providers the gateway serves, in fallback order for model "auto". Golden rule: free and keyless. A copy at <state dir>/providers.json (default ~/.ai-gateway/providers.json) replaces this built-in list, so a broken provider is a config edit, not a rebuild. kind openai: an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (url, optional models_url). kind cli: a vendor CLI run headless (bin, ask_args with {prompt}, optional model_args with {model}). default_model empty = the first model the provider lists. min_interval_seconds spaces calls out; daily_limit 0 = no cap known. A CLI runs in an empty scratch directory with the entry's env added. disabled: true keeps an entry in the file without serving it.

providers.note: Off until default_model names a free hosted model from `opencode models`: on betelgeuse opencode's own default is the local bill-the-cat model, so it would ask Bill itself.
